scope: Observation-scaled real amplitude roughness, keeping original common phase freedom and qualification gates
policy: Regularize real amplitude only; do not constrain or lowpass the common phase or independent departures
Use exact third derivative integral of the clamped cubic amplitude splines, with midpoint quadrature exact on each knot interval
Scale from the actually fitted observation residual, not analytic fixture noise, phase, amplitudes or heldout outcomes
The residual scale is a proxy, not calibrated real recording uncertainty; derivative penalty is a soft prior, not a strict bandlimit
Keep every original phase/root/power/stereo and support gate; retain the dense positive even if it fails
No weight or cutoff sweep based on gate outcomes; all17, original33 and individual14kHz remain necessary before original E
No real-source read, profile, C/runtime, audio, room or media changes in this principle stage
